doc.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025

title: Rochester jazz: Bill Evans and the Pythod
summary: He saw Bill Evans every year in Rochester and recalls the Pythod and drummer Vinnie.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Well you know who I used to see at — I can’t remember the name of that place, was it the Glass Onion? Rochester?

I saw Bill Evans every year. He came every year for two days. I never missed any of the shows. I would sit there and pay them again to see the second show. And most of the time he’d play different music anyway. Oh it was remarkable. You know Rochester was — I’d go to the Pythod.
The Pythod. You know I’m from Rochester.
So you know Vinnie Ruggerio and all those guys?
Both of my daughters live in the Rochester area.
